evidence_quotes: verzoek van [appellant] om handhaving van drie aan de bij besluit van 22 juni 2012 verleende aansluitvergunning met nummer R02773
rationale: The available summary contains only a procedural sentence regarding the rejection of a request for enforcement (handhaving) of three conditions attached to a connection permit ('aansluitvergunning met nummer R02773') granted by 'het college'. In Dutch administrative practice, an 'aansluitvergunning' granted by a college (B&W, GS, or waterschap) may refer to a municipal sewer connection (rioolaansluiting, where 'R' sometimes denotes riool), a road access connection under a provincial/municipal road bylaw, or another utility/facility connection. Because the text contains no explicit reference to water, sewerage, or a specific statute, water versus non-water subject matter cannot be reliably determined from the summary alone.
